thread:
alex.k: Hey team — first on-call shift tomorrow and I noticed I can’t open the infra runbook: /runbooks/infra/oncall-v2. Getting a 403. Who should I ping for access?
priya.m: @alex.k welcome! ping @devon for Confluence perms, they usually handle access. Also check the runbook mirror in GitHub if you need it fast: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/tree/main/infra 
alex.k: thanks — devon, can you add me? my ID is alex.k@redwood.com. Also quick n00b Q: what’s the minimal ack/notify flow we follow for PD pages?
oncall-bot: Reminder: On-call rotation docs -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/oncall/pages. Use the PD schedule calendar and the runbook checklist before paging.
devon: added you to Confluence, you should have access now :thumbsup:
sam.t: For PagerDuty: on first page —> Acknowledge (15 min) -> Triage & Decide -> Escalate if not resolved. We try to avoid immediate escalation unless CPU/latency SLOs broken.
alex.k: where’s the quick checklist? e.g., how to capture logs and attach to incident?
priya.m: checklist is at the top of the infra runbook. Quick steps: 1) grab the incident id from PD, 2) run `rdw-logs get <service> --since 15m > /tmp/incident-<id>.log`, 3) attach to PD incident and paste short summary.
alex.k: helpful — can you paste the exact command for logs?
priya.m: sure: ```bash
rdw-logs get auth-service --since 15m > /tmp/incident-$INCIDENT_ID.log
```
alex.k: awesome. Any training / shadow session I can join before my shift?
devon: We have 30m shadow slots today 3:30pm and 4:30pm on the oncall-training calendar. I can shadow with you at 4:30 if that works.
alex.k: 4:30 works, thanks! Also, is there a postmortem template we should use when incidents are done?
sam.t: use the template in the ops repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/blob/main/postmortem-template.md — fill timeline, impact, root cause, mitigations, owner. Keep it short.
alex.k: great, thanks everyone. One last tiny thing — if I need to reroute traffic temporarily to a fallback model endpoint, is there a playbook?
priya.m: yes, see section "fallback-routing" in the infra runbook. TL;DR: update traffic policy in the routing service: `rctl routes set --service model-proxy --policy fallback-v1` then verify with `rctl routes status model-proxy`. Then post in #incidents with the change.
alex.k: got it. See you at 4:30, and appreciate the quick help :heart:
priya.m: same — welcome to on-call!
